text: The Tests `suite` job was still running when this review gathered its data, so this review does not include its result.

The commit message says an empty list "made every recorded compile ... read as instrumented". On `main`, `if not wanted` (`tools/check_links.py:774`) already decided nothing for an empty list. The hole was a non-empty list with no `-fsanitize=` word. For an empty list, this change only adds the note.
